name: faz-telai
description: Compartilhamento de tela entre amigos, direto no navegador.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client && tsc -p e2e
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:e2e
